name: The Censor DX Edition
description:
🔽Story🔽

Yuto Fujimoto is a shut-in with a knack for computers and an unhealthy obsession with idols. When Facibook offers him a job censoring adult content, he takes it reluctantly, spending his days scrubbing images that violate community guidelines.

At first, the work is mind-numbing. However, as the flagged posts pile up, Yuto starts noticing something strange. Behind the filters and file names lie hidden connections to three women in his life: Misa, the married apartment manager. Yui, his favorite idol. And Rika, the pious nun at the local church. All of them are harboring secrets he never expected to uncover.

What starts as a mundane job takes a wild turn when Yuto mistakenly lets adult content slip past moderation. The strange reactions from his neighbors and the media suggest something's changed...

🔽Game Overview🔽

Each day is split into four time slots, giving you time to earn money, rise through the ranks, and explore the city while deepening your connections with NPCs.

You’ll progress through five ranks, from Intern to Manager, unlocking better pay and greater freedom with each promotion. With that freedom comes opportunity: once you’ve proven yourself, you can start making “mistakes” on purpose, letting explicit content slip through to quietly raise the world’s CHAOS level without getting fired for it.

As the world slips deeper into chaos, the NPCs begin to behave in unexpected and perverse ways. Dialogue shifts, outfits change, and new lewd events are unlocked.

Conquer Misa Hashimoto’s route to buy a bus card at the convenience store. This opens up the Church, Convention, and Police Station—each packed with new content and minigames.

The newest update includes all DLC, featuring a fresh new target of desire.

🔽Game Play🔽

Every day consists of four periods—Morning, Afternoon, Evening and Night. Plan your schedule wisely to boost relationships, earn cash, and uncover secrets.

Find opportunities to get closer to the heroine. Rank up as a censor and keep driving the world further into chaos!

Unique missions and mini-games await at both the Church and the Convention. Engage in confessionals, sing hymns, or dive into the more depraved side of religious devotion.

🔽Characters🔽

🔽Features🔽

●Over a dozen mini-games and side missions bring extra layers to gameplay.

●Enjoy 60+ pixel-art erotic animations and more than 200 CG variations.

●Three major zones and over 30 unique NPCs await. Most female NPCs are fair game.

●Expect surprise cameos from Chiho, Lilith from NTRaholic and other beloved characters from games publishing by Mango Party.

※Characters and visuals borrowed from other titles are all officially licensed and approved.
